summary.tldr: Raises the prison minimum for repeat motor vehicle theft and limits conditional sentences for those offences.
what_it_does: Raises the minimum prison term to three years for a third or later motor vehicle theft conviction prosecuted by indictment, with a maximum of 10 years.
Requires courts to give primary consideration to whether the theft was committed for the benefit of, at the direction of, or in association with a criminal organization.
Bars conditional sentence orders for motor vehicle theft offences prosecuted by indictment under section 333.1 of the Criminal Code.
who_it_affects: People convicted of motor vehicle theft
summary.background: It changes section 333.1 of the Criminal Code, which deals with motor vehicle theft.
